start.title: [TODO:ar] The Long Road
start.text:
[TODO:ar] Mary rests against the donkey at dusk.
The road to Bethlehem stretches on.

push_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Slow Your Step
push_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] She winces with the child within.
Match her pace, not your own.

turnback_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] The Path Forward
turnback_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Heaven has chosen this road.
Keep walking with her.

bethlehem.title: [TODO:ar] Lamps of Bethlehem
bethlehem.text:
[TODO:ar] The town is full for the census.
Her time draws near.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Force will open no door tonight.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Soften Your Voice
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Anger turns the doors away.
Approach the keeper in peace.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You bow your head and ask.

inn.title: [TODO:ar] No Room for You
inn.text:
[TODO:ar] "There is no room here, traveler.
Only the stable behind remains."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The night will be too harsh.

street_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Shelter Is Offered
street_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The wind is cold and bitter.
A stable waits behind the inn.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You guide her behind the inn.

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Receive the Gift
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Even a stable is a kindness tonight.
Receive what is given.

stable.title: [TODO:ar] A Quiet Stable
stable.text:
[TODO:ar] Hay, lamplight, and gentle breath.
Mary settles against the wall.

complain_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] See the Beauty
complain_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] This humble shelter is enough.
Ready the place with care.

birth.title: [TODO:ar] Her Time Has Come
birth.text:
[TODO:ar] A soft cry rises through the night.
The child is born.

run_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Stay With Them
run_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] This moment is yours to hold.
Return to her side.

manger.title: [TODO:ar] Wrapped in Quiet
manger.text:
[TODO:ar] She lays him in the manger.
The world is still — and all is well.
